title: Vibrant Spicy Jamaican Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tender beef, aromatic spices, and a hint of resinous scotch bonnet peppers, perfect for a hangover cure. This low-calorie-friendly dish is made with mantecare-emulsify technique to create a rich and aerated texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef cubes with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes in batches until they are browned on all sides.
Add the diced onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, and allspice to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and browned beef to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Simmer the stew in the oven for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew until it is slightly smooth, then stir in the mantecare-emulsify mixture.
